name: twilight-city-balcony-neon-baddie
image_purpose: Urban nightlife and workwear-inspired social content

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic twilight balcony portrait with high-visibility workwear styling and a city construction backdrop.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman in her early 20s with long straight platinum-to-honey blonde hair, medium bronzed skin with natural texture, clear protective safety glasses, black fingerless gloves, a neon lime high-visibility vest with reflective silver strips worn over a secure black top, denim shorts with a comfortable fit, and a tan utility belt with loose suspenders. prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium shot from the thighs upward at eye level with a slightly wide-angle perspective. The woman stands on a high-rise balcony with a black metal railing, both hands lightly holding the vest edges. Include a blurred urban cityscape, hotel architecture, large construction crane silhouette and blue-to-orange twilight sky.

prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical urban portrait, full-frame camera with 28mm lens, medium depth of field, realistic reflective fabric, natural skin texture, mild flash grain, no watermark.
